common_name: Monkey Business Hosta (Yellow-Margined Sport of Funky Monkey)

planting.note: Plant divisions in early fall or spring in moist, humus-rich, well-drained soil in light to partial shade, giving the clump room to reach its full, vigorous mature spread.

directions: Monkey Business arose as a sport of the chartreuse, dark-petioled 'Funky Monkey' discovered at Naylor Creek Nursery by Marco and Joyce Fransen, and it keeps its parent's dark purple petioles while trading solid-colored leaves for a bold, irregular marginal pattern instead. New spring growth emerges nearly all green, with the wide margin differentiating soon after into yellow and brightening further toward cream-white as the season progresses and with more light exposure, while the thick, arrow-shaped center stays a deep, glossy green. Established clumps build into a substantial, vigorous mound and produce fertile, pale lavender flowers on scapes in summer. Give it consistently moist, humus-rich soil and protection from hot midday sun, which can scorch the pale margin.
